steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with the application name 'DigitalSolutionsPro' and package name 'com.digitalsolutionspro.app', including a unique app_id.

steps.title: Configure Backend API Schema and Logic
steps.description: Set up api_schema.json, declaring no online backend but documenting the client-side 'project_quote' calculation logic.

steps.title: Set up Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Configure the app's build.gradle file for Java 8 compatibility, SDK versions, and necessary Android Support Library dependencies.

steps.title: Declare Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml, defining the application, main activity, and internet permission (if required for potential image loading, though local drawables are used).

steps.title: Define App Resources (strings.xml, styles.xml)
steps.description: Create string resources for the app name, spinner arrays, and define a custom theme with Material Light styling.

steps.title: Create Drawable Resources
steps.description: Define XML drawables for card backgrounds and placeholder image references for UI elements like the hero image and testimonial avatars.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout Structure
steps.description: Lay out the primary user interface using a ScrollView and a vertical LinearLayout to organize all sections of the app.

steps.title: Design Hero, About, and Services Sections
steps.description: Implement the UI for the Header, Hero section, About Us (Core Values), and Services sections within activity_main.xml, using ImageView, TextView, and Button components.

steps.title: Design Project Quote Calculator UI
steps.description: Integrate UI elements for the calculator: Spinners for service type and complexity, a SeekBar for estimated hours, CheckBoxes for add-ons, and TextViews to display the calculated total and breakdown.

steps.title: Design Testimonials, Contact Form, and Footer UI
steps.description: Implement UI for the Testimonials, Contact Form (EditTexts, Spinner, Button, feedback TextView), and the Footer sections.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java: UI Initialization
steps.description: Write Java code in MainActivity to initialize all UI components by finding their IDs from the layout and setting up adapter for spinners.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java: Setup Quote Calculator Listeners
steps.description: Add event listeners for spinners, seek bar, and checkboxes in the calculator section to trigger quote updates.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java: Project Quote Calculation Logic
steps.description: Develop the `updateProjectQuote` method to perform the offline calculation based on user inputs, parse string values from spinners, and format the output.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java: Setup Contact Form Listeners and Simulation
steps.description: Add an onClick listener for the contact form's submit button and implement the `simulateContactFormSubmission` method, including basic validation and local feedback.

steps.title: Building DigitalSolutionsPro
steps.description: Assemble the Android application, ensuring all components are correctly integrated and the app builds without errors.
